headlines.description: Bournemouth moved a step closer to automatic qualification for the Europa League round of 16 after coming from behind with 10 men to win 2-1 at Celta Vigo.
headlines.shortLinkText: 10-man Bournemouth beat Celta Vigo to top Europa League

headlines.description: AC Milan produced a second-half fightback from 2-0 down to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Piraeus and kick-start their Europa League campaign.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milan rally to win at Olympiacos to kick-start UEL campaign

headlines.description: Crystal Palace delivered Thomas Frank a first victory since taking charge after they came back to beat 10-man Real Sociedad 2-1 in the Europa League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Frank gets 1st win as Palace rally to beat 10-man Real Sociedad

headlines.description: Sunderland were left frustrated again in their Europa League campaign after drawing 1-1 with Jagiellonia Bialystok at the Stadium of Light.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland left frustrated after draw to Jagiellonia Bialystok in Europa League
